Is the new BMW X5 an improvement on the old car?
The all-new BMW X5 is here!
Previous editions of the BMW X5 have been an evolution of the prior model. However, it’s fair to say the newest X5 is more of a revolution than an evolution!
There’s a whole host of changes to this car, both inside and outside. But do all of these changes make it a better car? Well, let’s take a closer look to find out, starting with the design…
